gripOrHq.title: Security Net Optimization
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a fort when scored. Ice installed on that fort gets +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Superior Net Barriers
gripOrHq.rulesText: All walls have +1 strength. When you score Superior Net Barriers, reveal as many walls as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed wall.

gripOrHq.title: Data Masons

heapOrArchives.title: Fortress Architects
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Cost to install ice is reduced by [1].

heapOrArchives.title: Investment Firm
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Take [1] from Investment Firm, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. Whenever [1] or more bits are added to your pool, you may put [2] from the bank on Investment Firm for each [1] you choose not to add to your pool. Effects that give you bits at the start of your turn cannot be used this way.

heapOrArchives.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
heapOrArchives.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

heapOrArchives.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
heapOrArchives.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Braindance Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Braindance Campaign when you rez it. Take [2] from Braindance Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Braindance Campaign.

discardCards.title: Hunt Club BBS
discardCards.rulesText: Expose up to three installed cards.

discardCards.title: Armored Fridge
discardCards.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: Clown
rig.rulesText: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

root.title: Jerusalem City Grid
